source: Authored at Step 13 from brief section 5.7.6 and plan section 10 (precheck presentation): label and consequence line in every form, no bare precheck verdict in a rollup line, and no rollup word where the listed not run condition stands.
precheck_consequence_line: Consequence: a precheck is not a gate run and classifies no stage.
listed_not_run_condition: a composing check stands listed as not run in whole or a limb that composes under the limb composing rule stands listed as not run
rollup_line_under_listed_not_run: Precheck. No rollup stands, because a composing check has not run.
